title: Bridgewell New Home Builder Warranties — Paying Systems Extension and Appliance Claims
content:
Two kinds of claim under Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties are paid against per-claim figures of the program: systems claims in the extension years and claims on builder-installed appliances.

## Systems extension claims

**Rule.** In the extension years, a claim in one of the program's systems extension trades is paid up to the program's per-claim systems extension limit less the program's systems extension deductible, within the program's total limit for systems claims in the extension years.

The amount paid on one claim is the lesser of the documented cost and the per-claim limit, less the deductible, and never less than zero. The extension years run from the second anniversary of the closing date through the systems end date. The total limit is measured by the systems extension repair payments Bridgewell has authorized in the extension years, less reversals of them.

**Worked through (hypothetical figures: per-claim limit 2500.00 USD, deductible 100.00 USD).**

| Documented cost | Lesser of the cost and 2500.00 | Less the 100.00 deductible | Paid |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1800.00 USD | 1800.00 | 1700.00 | 1700.00 USD |
| 3200.00 USD | 2500.00 | 2400.00 | 2400.00 USD |
| 80.00 USD | 80.00 | below zero | 0.00 USD |

**Points of judgement.**

- A claim falls under this rule only when it is in one of the trades the program lists for the extension years.
- The deductible is subtracted after the per-claim limit is applied, from the lesser of the documented cost and that limit.

## Appliance claims

**Rule.** A covered appliance in the program's covered appliance types is repaired or replaced up to the program's per-appliance claim limit, with the program's appliance service fee billed per claim.

**Illustrated (hypothetical figures: per-claim limit 1500.00 USD, service fee 75.00 USD).** A covered dishwasher's repair is provided up to 1500.00 USD on the claim, and the homeowner is billed the 75.00 USD service fee on that claim. A second appliance claim is billed its own 75.00 USD service fee.
